{"_id": {"$oid": "6a07ac7050fb022788293c91"}, "id": "CUSTOM_SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER_4C7DD61F", "nombre": "PRODUCTOS", "descripcion": "PRODUCTOS FILTRADOS POR ALMACEN", "sistema": "SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER", "categoria": "Inventarios", "parametros": ["ID_ALMACEN"], "sql": "Select 
'PRODUCTO' AS TABLA,
ct.Name CATEGORIA,
pg.Name GRUPO,
p.code ID,
p.Name DESCRIPCION,
u.Code UM,
puni.Items RENDIMIENTO,
pw.LastCost COSTO,
pw.IdWarehouse ID_ALMACEN
from Products P
inner join ProductGroups pg on pg.id = p.IdProductGroup
INNER JOIN ProductWarehouses PW on pw.IdProduct = p.Id
LEFT join ProductSubGroups psg on psg.Id = p.IdProductSubGroup
inner join ProductUnits puni on puni.IdProduct = p.Id
inner join Units u on u.Id = puni.IdUnit
LEFT join Categories CT on CT.ID = pg.IdCategory
WHERE 
PW.IdWarehouse = {ID_ALMACEN} AND
puni.IsDefault = 1
ORDER BY 
pg.Name,
psg.Name,
p.code,
puni.IsDefault DESC
", "created_by": "carlosruz@edarsa.com.mx", "created_at": "2026-05-15T23:29:52.589814+00:00", "active": true, "validated": true, "validation_timestamp": "2026-05-15T23:29:52.589667+00:00"}

{"_id": {"$oid": "6a07b1e1ab02ae6d4eae925a"}, "id": "CUSTOM_SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER_83AD97F8", "nombre": "INSUMOS CONSUMIDOS", "descripcion": "DEVUELVE LOS INSUMOS CONSUMIDOS EN UN RANGO DE FECHAS POR ALMACEN Y SUCURSAL", "sistema": "SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER", "categoria": "Inventarios", "parametros": ["FECHAINICIAL", "FECHAFINAL", "ALMACEN"], "sql": "SELECT
'CONSUMOS' CONSULTA,
ALMACEN.Name ALMACEN,
CASE WHEN ct.POSCATEGORY = '2' THEN 'ALIMENTOS' WHEN CT.POSCATEGORY = '1' THEN 'BEBIDAS' ELSE 'OTROS' END  CLASIFICADOR,
Gp.NAME GRUPO, 
P.Code AS INSUMO,
P.NAME DESCRIPCION,
U.CODE UM,
Inventory.Quantity as CONSUMIDO,
Inventory.cost COSTO_PROM
  FROM [NSBACKOFFICE].[dbo].[Inventory]
INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.ID = Inventory.IdProduct
INNER JOIN Warehouses ALMACEN ON ALMACEN.Id = Inventory.IdWareHouse
INNER JOIN Companies EMPRESA ON EMPRESA.Id = ALMACEN.IdCompany
INNER JOIN InventoryConcepts CONCEPTOS ON CONCEPTOS.Id = Inventory.IdInventoryConcept
INNER JOIN Productgroups GP on GP.ID = P.IdProductGroup
INNER JOIN Categories CT ON CT.ID = gp.IdCategory
INNER JOIN ProductUnits puni on puni.IdProduct = p.Id AND PUNI.ISDEFAULT = 1
INNER JOIN Units u on u.Id = puni.IdUnit
where 
Inventory.[Date] BETWEEN {FECHAINICIAL} AND {FECHAFINAL}
AND
CONCEPTOS.Code IN('SPV') AND
ALMACEN.Name LIKE '%' + {ALMACEN} + '%'


", "created_by": "carlosruz@edarsa.com.mx", "created_at": "2026-05-15T23:53:05.385782+00:00", "active": true, "validated": true, "validation_timestamp": "2026-05-15T23:53:05.385435+00:00"}

{"_id": {"$oid": "6a07aa1e50fb022788293c7d"}, "id": "CUSTOM_SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER_14F42D7D", "nombre": "ALMACENCES", "descripcion": "RELACION DE ALMACENCES", "sistema": "SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER", "categoria": "Inventarios", "parametros": ["EMPRESA", "IDALMACEN"], "sql": "SELECT 
COMPANIES.LegalName AS EMPRESA,
Warehouses.Code AS CODIGO,
Warehouses.Name AS DESCRIPCION,
CASE WHEN 
    Warehouses.IsConsumption = '1' 
    THEN 'CONSUMO' 
    ELSE 'BODEGA' 
END TIPO,

FROM

", "created_by": "carlosruz@edarsa.com.mx", "created_at": "2026-05-15T23:19:58.947178+00:00", "active": true, "validated": true, "validation_timestamp": "2026-05-15T23:19:58.946942+00:00"}

{"_id": {"$oid": "6a07ae9650fb022788293c9f"}, "id": "CUSTOM_SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER_EEB05068", "nombre": "INVENTARIOS FISICOS", "descripcion": "DEVUELVE LOS INVENTARIOS FISICOS EN UN RANGO DE FECHAS POR ALMACEN Y SUCURSAL", "sistema": "SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER", "categoria": "Inventarios", "parametros": ["FECHAINICIAL", "FECHAFINAL", "EMPRESA", "ALMACEN"], "sql": "
SELECT 
'INVENTARIOS' AS CONSULTA,
CASE WHEN
    (SELECT TOP 1 PhysicalInventory.ID FROM PhysicalInventory WHERE PhysicalInventory.[Date] BETWEEN {FECHAINICIAL} AND {FECHAFINAL} AND PhysicalInventory.IdWareHouse = INV.IdWareHouse ORDER BY PhysicalInventory.ID ASC ) = INV.Id
    THEN 'INICIAL'
    ELSE 
        CASE WHEN 
            (SELECT TOP 1 PhysicalInventory.ID FROM PhysicalInventory WHERE PhysicalInventory.[Date] BETWEEN {FECHAINICIAL} AND {FECHAFINAL} AND PhysicalInventory.IdWareHouse = INV.IdWareHouse ORDER BY PhysicalInventory.ID DESC ) = INV.Id
        THEN 'FINAL'
        ELSE ''
        END
    END INVENTARIO,
ALMACEN.Name AS ALMACEN,
INV.[Date] AS FECHA,
INV.NUMBER AS FOLIO,
'PRODUCTOS' AS TIPO,
P.Code AS CODIGO,
INVD.Cost AS COSTO,
INVD.Quantity FISICOALMACEN1,
PUNIT.Items AS RENDIMIENTO,
UM.Name AS UNIDAD,
INVD.STOCK AS [INVENTARIO.1],
INVD.[Difference] AS [diferenciaalmacen1]
FROM 
PhysicalInventory INV 
INNER JOIN PhysicalInventoryDetail INVD  ON INVD.IdPhysicalInventory = INV.Id
INNER JOIN Warehouses ALMACEN ON ALMACEN.Id = INV.IdWareHouse
INNER JOIN Products P ON P.Id = INVD.IdProduct
INNER JOIN ProductUnits PUNIT ON PUNIT.IdProduct = INVD.IdProduct AND PUNIT.ID = INVD.IdProductUnit
INNER JOIN Units UM on UM.Id = PUNIT.IdUnit
INNER JOIN Companies EMPRESA ON EMPRESA.Id = INV.IdCompany
WHERE 
INV.[Date] BETWEEN {FECHAINICIAL} AND {FECHAFINAL}
AND EMPRESA.LegalName LIKE '%' + {EMPRESA} + '%'
AND ALMACEN.Name LIKE '%' + {ALMACEN} + '%'

ORDER BY CONVERT(DATE,INV.[Date],301),INV.Id, P.Code
", "created_by": "carlosruz@edarsa.com.mx", "created_at": "2026-05-15T23:39:02.432765+00:00", "active": true, "validated": true, "validation_timestamp": "2026-05-15T23:39:02.432519+00:00"}

{"_id": {"$oid": "6a07af7450fb022788293caa"}, "id": "CUSTOM_SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER_C8055659", "nombre": "KARDEX ", "descripcion": "DEVUELVE LOS MOVIMIENTOS EN UN RANGO DE FECHAS POR ALMACEN Y SUCURSAL", "sistema": "SOFRESATAURANT_ENTER", "categoria": "Inventarios", "parametros": ["FECHAINICIAL", "FECHAFINAL", "ALMACEN"], "sql": "SELECT

Inventory.ID AS DOCUMENTO,
